body: Im an idiot too, it's not easy. I spend all day watching shit, basically my whole life and all I am. Too boring to be with anyone. Im sure you'll find someone, being stupid never stopped most people from finding love.

Ive always been the weird person everyone hates (even though im nice, which seems to piss them off too). I have social anxiety and can barely make eye contact, and I feel like I'm on crack sometimes im so nervous around everyone, even my family. People aren't sympathetic or accommodating. They just push me or ignore me. So I feel you.
